newsitem.title: USA: Carnival, Hyundai start Asia cruise.
newsitem.headline: Carnival, Hyundai start Asia cruise.

text.p: Carnival Corp said Thursday it has signed an agreement with a division of Hyundai to begin a vacation cruise venture in Asia.
The venture will target the Asian middle class, which Carnival estimates will be twice the population of the U.S. middle class by the year 2001.

Carnival and Hyundai Merchant Marine, a division of the Hyundai Group that operates more than 200 commercial vessels, would each own 50 percent of the new venture, said Carnival spokesman Tim Gallagher.
The venture, which has yet to be named, is subject to ancillary agreements but is expected to be finalized over the next 60 to 90 days, Gallagher said. He declined to specify the cost of the venture.

The venture will acquire a 1,400-passenger ship that presently travels in the Caribbean and elsewhere, the company said. It is scheduled to begin its Asia route in the spring of 1998, traveling from Inchon, Korea to China.
In April Carnival acquired a 29.54 percent equity stake in Airtours Plc, a British holiday tour operator.
